dish_drainer_door.description: Dish-drainer unit with door - 1 rh or lh door - 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray - 155 degree hinges
interior_confirmed: 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
dish_drainer_door.notes: THE DISH-DRAINER SECTIONS MIRROR THEIR OWN FAMILIES. H.36 has no side-hinged wall unit and its dish-drainer section has no door type either; H.48 has both. The 155 degree hinge is stated here and on the two-door type and nowhere else on these pages - it is an interior fact, recorded, not drawn. ONE CODE, BOTH HANDS: the hand is an order variant, never a second article.

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front, hinged on a vertical edge. Which edge is hinge_side, chosen per order and never guessed.

dish_drainer_two_doors.description: Dish-drainer unit with doors - 2 doors - 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray - 155 degree hinges
interior_confirmed: 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
dish_drainer_two_doors.notes: One code, W.90, exactly as the plain wall two-door type of the same family.

front_layout.note: Two doors meeting in the middle. Equal widths are a representation assumption consistent with the drawing, not a stated dimension.

dish_drainer_top_hung_door.description: Dish-drainer unit with top-hung door - 1 top-hung door - 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
interior_confirmed: 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
dish_drainer_top_hung_door.notes: Same six widths and the same suffix 02 as the H.36 dish-drainer top-hung type. Two families agreeing, still not a rule.

front_layout.note: One door covering the full front, hinged along its top edge.

dish_drainer_push_up_door.description: Dish-drainer unit with push-up door - 1 push-up door - 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray - interior Valencia handle - no Push-pull device
interior_confirmed: 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
dish_drainer_push_up_door.notes: Starts at W.60, like every push-up type read so far.

front_layout.note: NO hinge_axis - see the plain wall push-up type.

dish_drainer_compound_2_top_hung.description: Compound dish-drainer unit with top-hung door - 1 top-hung door - 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
interior_confirmed: 1 stainless steel rack with drip tray
dish_drainer_compound_2_top_hung.notes: Carries the same printed rule as its H.36 twin: 'In compound wall units, the dish-drainer rack is fitted in the widest unit.' NO width restriction on this position, while all four simple positions have one - the compounds are where the catalog stops forbidding it.

dish_drainer_compound_2_push_up.description: Compound dish-drainer unit with push-up door - 1 push-up door - 1 x 90 cm stainless steel rack with drip tray - 1 shelf - 2 x 90 cm compartments - interior Valencia handle - no Push-pull device

Suffix 11 - it is neither the plain push-up compound's 08 nor the top-hung dish-drainer compound's 06, so the two suffix families do not compose.
